outlook.statement: The Board is of the considered view that continued deployment of the Company's financial, managerial and other resources in the Business may not be commercially prudent and that an exit from the Business, by way of sale, transfer, slump sale, business transfer or other legally permissible mode, would be in the best interests of the Company and its stakeholders.
